topic: Production hosting, region, topology and PostgreSQL HA/PITR tier
why_unresolved: Production geography, capacity, budget and backup tier require actual deployment selection.
latest_phase: P13 / before production infrastructure or production data, whichever is earlier
default_behavior: Local/synthetic environment only; portable OCI + PostgreSQL. Northflank/R2 are development candidates, not production approval.

topic: Object storage/CDN provider and production delivery policy
why_unresolved: Exact S3-compatible storage/CDN profile requires the media integration decision.
default_behavior: Adapter/local fixture storage; platform asset UUID/version/checksum remain canonical.

topic: Image/TTS/STT providers, licences and voice cast
source: TS §40.2 ADR-007 p22; Curriculum §19.2 p16; TD §35 p20
why_unresolved: Provider quality, data use, licence/consent, varieties and voice cast require the approved integration spike.
latest_phase: P5 / before generation/scoring integration or media batch
default_behavior: Deterministic adapters/fixtures; no unapproved provider payload or production media. Required published media stays pre-generated.

topic: Versioned speech confidence/target-feature policy and pilot calibration
why_unresolved: Usability thresholds depend on selected provider/target/language and must not be invented as universal language scores.
latest_phase: P5 before usable provider evidence; refine with P12 pilot before broad rollout
default_behavior: Unusable/unapproved evaluation becomes speech_unavailable with no mastery/mistake/scheduler effect. Use controlled fixtures for contract tests.

topic: Initial approved local/free text AI provider/model/runtime
why_unresolved: Exact local/free model choice requires quality/privacy/quota/current-terms spike; no provider is promised permanently free.
latest_phase: P8 / before shared foundation provider integration
default_behavior: Provider ports/doubles only until approved. paid_inference_enabled=false; monthly_paid_budget=0; no paid fallback.

topic: Learner conversation retention and provider data-handling policy
why_unresolved: Exact retention/deletion/downstream handling policy must be approved for actual learner data route.
latest_phase: P9 / before public learner AI or retaining conversation payload
default_behavior: Learner AI off without consent/policy; minimal/off retention and scripted fallback; raw audio remains transient under fixed policy.

topic: Observable production backend and operational retention configuration
why_unresolved: Exact analytics/observability backend and bounded operational retention are deployment choices not made in the baseline.
latest_phase: P11 / before reference monitoring/restore acceptance; revalidate P13
default_behavior: OpenTelemetry-compatible ports, bounded/pseudonymous metadata; no raw answers/audio/secrets in telemetry.

topic: Launch countries, minors/consent, processors and public privacy approvals
source: Formal §33.2 p21; TS §40.2 ADR-011 p23; AI AI-ADR-008 p20
why_unresolved: Real launch jurisdictions, age policy and actual processors must be approved for the intended public release.
latest_phase: P13 / BEFORE any real-user public registration or public EU AI flow
default_behavior: No real-user public registration; synthetic/private testing. No invented universal age or legal retention threshold.

why_unresolved: Lingvessa is approved as a working name; public brand clearance is separate.
default_behavior: Use Lingvessa as working project name; no claim of cleared trademark.

topic: M02–M12 module-map approval and lexical inventory calibration
why_unresolved: 12-module architecture is fixed; authoring approval and lexical targets require full inventory/pilot review before bulk production.
default_behavior: Keep locked M01 fixtures; no bulk rollout; ~800–1000 active/250–400 receptive are design targets, not external CEFR mandates.
owner: Curriculum/content / language leads and product owner

why_unresolved: Readiness bands require pilot data, item analysis and expert approval.
latest_phase: P12 / only before optional Level Test activation
default_behavior: Optional test inactive until calibrated; it never blocks A2 and makes no external certification claim.

topic: Validated writing/conversation rubric before optional AI mastery effect
why_unresolved: Default AI writing/conversation is advisory; any evidence-bearing path needs approved calibrated evaluator/rubric.
latest_phase: P9 / before enabling such evidence; may remain advisory through P12
default_behavior: Free-form AI practice/advice has no direct mastery effect. Only approved structured evaluator contracts may emit bounded evidence.
